title: Deleting an older snapshot
claim: Deleting an older snapshot keeps the blocks that newer snapshots still use, so the newest one still restores the whole volume.
alt: Two panels. Before: snapshot 1 holds blocks A, B and C, snapshot 2 holds a new block B and points to A and C in snapshot 1, snapshot 3 holds a new block C. After snapshot 1 is deleted: block A stays with snapshot 2, and snapshot 3 still restores the whole volume.
